exposure: Birth order of the index infant
outcome: Time to cessation of exclusive breast-feeding
cohort: 592 mothers of index infants less than twelve months old in Ethiopia
finding: Maternal and paternal occupation, place of residence, postnatal counseling on exclusive breast-feeding, mode of delivery, and birth order of the index infant were significant predictors of cessation of exclusive breast-feeding.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant predictor of cessation of exclusive breast-feeding.
